policy_rationale: X prohibits directly attacking other people on the basis of protected categories. It targets abuse motivated by hatred/prejudice/intolerance, especially abuse that silences historically marginalized voices. Enforcement scales with severity: severe/repetitive slur or trope usage to harass/intimidate may require Post removal; moderate/isolated usage may instead get visibility limits. Context within a larger conversation (including consensual reclaimed use) can make otherwise-hateful content non-violating.
prohibited: Hateful references: targeting individuals/groups with content referencing violence or violent events where a protected category was the primary target/victim, with intent to harass (e.g., genocides like the Holocaust, lynchings)
Incitement - inciting fear or spreading fearful stereotypes about a protected category (e.g., 'all [religious group] are terrorists')
Incitement - inciting others to harass members of a protected category on or off platform
Incitement - inciting others to discriminate via denial of economic support to an individual/group due to protected-category membership (excludes genuine political commentary/boycotts/protests)
Slurs and Tropes: targeting others with repeated slurs, tropes, or content intended to degrade or reinforce negative/harmful stereotypes about a protected category
Dehumanization of a group based on religion, caste, age, disability, serious disease, national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, or sexual orientation
Hateful Imagery: logos/symbols/images whose purpose is to promote hostility/malice based on a protected category (e.g., Nazi swastika, dehumanizing alterations, Holocaust-referencing manipulations)
Hateful Imagery in live video, account bio, profile, or header; sending an individual unsolicited hateful imagery
Hateful Profile: using hateful images/symbols in profile image or header; using username/display name/bio for targeted harassment or expressing hate toward a person/group/protected category
context_required: Slur/trope usage where it is unclear whether context is abusive or part of a consensual reclaimed conversation - X may need to hear from the targeted person before acting
Posts that appear hateful in isolation but may not be within a larger conversation
allowed: Reclaimed/consensual in-group use of terms typically considered slurs, where context is not abusive
Content where larger-conversation context shows non-abusive intent
Political commentary, or content relating to boycotts or protests, that is not inciting discrimination based on protected category
Counterspeech, condemnation, or reporting of hateful content
examples_violating: All [religious group] are terrorists and shouldn't be allowed here
If you see anyone wearing [religious symbol], grab it off them and post the pics
[repeated slur targeting someone for their protected category, to harass]
Profile header set to a Nazi swastika
examples_allowed: Quoting a hateful reply to call it out and condemn it
Members of the community using a reclaimed term among themselves
I'm boycotting [business] over its political stance [policy/boycott commentary]
Academic post analyzing historical hate propaganda
enforcement: Graduated. Severe/repetitive slur or trope usage to harass/intimidate: Post removal (REMOVE) and possible read-only period. Moderate/isolated usage to harass: visibility restriction (LABEL / reduced reach). Hateful Profile violations: account suspension. Reclaimed/contextual use: KEEP. Ambiguous slur context: KEEP with low confidence (X may require target self-report).
